title: Open world puzzle exploration game
author: Comfortablebro
selftext:
Hi,

my try.. to be honest i feel burned out. The game doesnt feel fun for me, maybe i was overworking myself too much too quickly. But i think the gameplay is lacking. Location amount is decent, enemy amount is decent.

version1 had different combat.

I am kind of abandoning this project or perhaps postponing indefinately. I have map editor, assets, game, and one more program that is important.

comments.author: Every-Prize4720
comments.body: looks pretty neat. wonder how fast that combat gets stale? otherwise not too bad.

replies.author: Comfortablebro
replies.body:
I have version where it comboes so one chain combos with another chain, possible to chain all one shots minibosses. But since i burned out on this little project i dont find any fun in anything.. lol

i think i got ok idea but making game fun is whole different thing, since i never coded any game finding fun takes time. And because i took a plan i had to use the ai so there was rushing. I had more ideas with mining, fishing, foragging minigames that seems decent but i didnt recorded it. I think going anywhere i want is not fun. My game had traveling, camping but that was even more unfun!
